title: Pasqal, a French startup that builds quantum processors using neutral atom technology, plans to go public via a SPAC merger at a $2B pre-money valuation (Bailey Lipschultz/Bloomberg)
summary: Bailey Lipschultz / Bloomberg: Pasqal, a French startup that builds quantum processors using neutral atom technology, plans to go public via a SPAC merger at a $2B pre-money valuation — Pasqal Holding SAS agreed to merge with a blank-check firm in a deal that values the combined company at $2 billion pre-money …
